_about: The one place NEXUS AI's models are named. Every id here was checked against OpenRouter's catalog and called successfully on 2026-10-09. The service refuses any id that is not in this file or does not end in ':free', so NEXUS can never route to a paid model. To change a model, edit this file; the first model in a list is used first and the rest are fallbacks, in order.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: General help for students and teachers.

longContext.label: Long context
longContext.description: Very long documents and conversations (up to 1,000,000 tokens).

image.label: Image
image.description: Understands a picture you attach. It does not create pictures.

decisions.label: Decisions
decisions.description: Structured yes/no and multiple-choice recommendations for teachers.

embeddings.label: Embeddings
embeddings.description: Turns text into vectors for searching by meaning.

rerank.label: Reranking
rerank.description: Orders search results by how well they answer a question.

models.name: NVIDIA Llama Nemotron Rerank VL 1B V2

transcription.label: Transcription
transcription.unavailable: OpenRouter lists 25 transcription models and none of them is free.

video.label: Video
video.unavailable: OpenRouter's video models are all billed per second of video. None is free.

audioGeneration.label: Audio generation
audioGeneration.unavailable: The only candidates (Google Lyria 3 previews) are not offered as ':free' models, so NEXUS will not call them.
